name: Vegan Peanut Brittle
short_description: Vegan brittle is the same wonderful recipe except for our vegan butter. Like a Professional Chef & a Candy Maker, I am very picky to the point of will not use it if it is not right, You'll never know it. So go ahead, check that disclaimer box, and get ready to experience the ultimate taste of hot fire peanut brittle - but be warned, this one is not for the faint of heart!

name: Bourbon/Whiskey Peanut Brittle
short_description: Indulge in the rich and sophisticated flavors of our bourbon and whiskey peanut brittle - a flavor sensation that will leave you wanting more. name: Old-Fashioned Peanut Brittle
short_description: Our Old-Fashioned Peanut Brittle is a special treat that is made using an old Southern family recipe from 1899. Each batch is hand-made with care and attention to detail, ensuring that every piece is perfectly crunchy, nutty, and delicious. We start with the highest quality ingredients, including red-skinned peanuts, Madagascar vanilla, Himalayan salt, and fresh butter. This combination of flavors creates a perfectly balanced brittle that is both buttery and crunchy. It's no surprise that this peanut brittle has become a favorite among our customers, as it is truly a classic treat that is perfect for any occasion. Whether enjoyed as a snack or given as a gift, this old-fashioned peanut brittle is sure to impress.
